hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Fuels Midterm Fever
hotspots.blurb: President Trump and Vice President JD Vance are crisscrossing the country with high-energy rallies in states like Arizona, Montana, Georgia, and Florida to boost GOP candidates ahead of the crucial midterms. The aggressive campaign schedule has drawn massive crowds alongside vocal local protests and intense political pushback.
hotspots.affect: High-intensity affective mobilization around upcoming elections, blending grassroots enthusiasm with sharp partisan division.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Ukraine Aid Cut Threat
hotspots.blurb: French National Rally leader Marine Le Pen has ignited fierce European and domestic debate by vowing to cut off financial aid to Ukraine within six months if elected president in 2027. Meanwhile, new polling suggests her momentum is surging, projecting a potential runoff duel.
hotspots.affect: Strong geopolitical defiance and alarm over European security architecture and foreign policy alignment.

hotspots.title: Trump Admin Hardline Immigration and Citizenship Push
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration is advancing aggressive immigration actions, including setting a restrictive 17,500 refugee cap that prioritizes white South Africans, suing California over noncitizen ballots, and reportedly investigating Rep. Ilhan Omar for potential denaturalization and deportation.
hotspots.affect: Deep moral and legal polarization regarding citizenship, civil rights, and nationalist policy enforcement.

hotspots.title: Judge Halts Trump Admin Actions
hotspots.blurb: Federal judges have stepped in to block several controversial Trump administration initiatives, including the mass unauthorized destruction of trees at a DC golf course and an attempt to close a major Maryland agricultural research center.
hotspots.affect: Heightened institutional friction and outrage over executive overreach versus judicial restraint.

hotspots.title: JD Vance Campaign Rhetoric Sparks Sharp Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Vice President JD Vance has drawn intense criticism and scrutiny from political opponents and corporate leaders alike following sharp campaign attacks on Democratic opponents and accusations of visa fraud directed at tech firms like Microsoft.
hotspots.affect: High-pitched political hostility and corporate defensiveness over cultural and economic nationalism.
